fix_specification.defect: SafeWriteManager.submit() previously used pre_state['etag'] to unconditionally overwrite caller's expected_etag, masking CAS conflicts and bypassing server 412 precondition checks.
fix_specification.resolution: Implemented three-branch CAS preservation: (1) caller expected_etag is strictly preserved; (2) caller expected_etag mismatch with server etag returns CONFLICT locally with 0 sends and audit log; (3) omitted expected_etag attaches server etag for default optimistic locking.
fix_specification.return_signature_adherence: Maintained file-wide (status, payload) 2-tuple return contract ('return CONFLICT, None'); prevented upstream unpack crashes in IsolatedAdapter.
fix_specification.empty_string_boundary: expected_etag='' is treated as explicit per 'is not None'; triggers CONFLICT if server etag is non-empty.

preserved_security_mechanisms.deny_target_filtering: isolated_test_v2.py: Gate 6 (lines 448-456; deny_ag08.json) & isolated_adapter.py: IsolatedAdapter._check_target() (line 117; allowlist default-deny)
